title: HB 586 (2025-2026 (136th General Assembly)): H. B. No. 586: Prohibit mailing out unsolicited absentee ballot request forms

(other) 3509.03(E) and 3511.02(E): bans mailing an unsolicited absentee ballot application to anyone (the earlier exception for the Secretary of State under 111.31 is struck)
(other) 3599.21: new offense for mailing an unsolicited absentee application; first offense first-degree misdemeanor, later offenses fifth-degree felony
(other) note: No voter ID, provisional ballot or proof-of-citizenship text. Sole version.
(note) Off this topic: the bill sets no ID or citizenship-proof rule.
